resources.string: KeeperFX ships no game files. Pick a folder that contains a complete KeeperFX installation, including the files copied from an original Dungeon Keeper CD.\n\nThe folder is copied into this app\'s private storage, which can take a few minutes.
This removes the imported installation including save games. The original folder you imported from is not touched.
Automatic — follow the device last used
Touch — always use the touch scheme
Mouse & keyboard — ignore the touch screen
Tap = left click · hold = right click · drag = paint area · two fingers = pan, pinch to zoom, twist to rotate · three finger tap = map · four finger tap = menu
